property_summary: For all callers and addresses, after calling setOwner(x) only the current owner (msg.sender == owner) may change the owner — i.e., if a caller is not the contract's owner before the call then setOwner must not succeed in changing owner; the mutant removes the require so a non-owner can change owner and thus violates this rule for some inputs.
change_summary: Remove the require entirely so onlyOwner imposes no restriction and setOwner can be called by anyone.
